{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|They rooted us out of the trees like Gungans searching for gumbols.|[[Tobias Pall]], referring to how quick the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] found them|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
'''Gumbols''' were creatures that grew in the trees of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] swamps. They were enjoyed by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], who often used gumbols to prepare breakfast foods.
